plugins.description: Google Gemini video understanding, Gemini CLI headless runs

plugins.name: claude-code-internals
plugins.description: Claude Code internals explorer

plugins.name: codex-plus
plugins.description: Enhanced OpenAI Codex CLI integration (multi-model, context classification)

plugins.name: stint
plugins.description: A bounded delegation that needs a session of its own, or one you ask for: spawn a Stint, or stand up an event/clock/self-round monitor

plugins.name: pdf-split
plugins.description: PDF chapter splitting

plugins.name: media-download
plugins.description: Media download via yt-dlp with QR decode and metadata extraction

plugins.name: caffeinate
plugins.description: macOS sleep prevention toggle with battery and network monitoring

plugins.name: safe-uninstall
plugins.description: Safely identify, investigate, and remove macOS programs with risk-assessed execution

plugins.name: voice-dictation
plugins.description: Push-to-talk voice dictation daemon (whisper.cpp) transcribing speech into the active window

plugins.name: hourly-digest
plugins.description: Consolidated hourly Slack and Gmail digest with /loop scheduling

plugins.name: handwriting
plugins.description: Apple Notes handwriting reader — scan Apple Pencil drawings via NoteStore.sqlite and read them multimodally

plugins.name: unfold
plugins.description: Linear chart writer — logs a decision at the moment the direction changes, and collapses an accumulated open set into axes that each name what they absorbed; asks rather than infers what the user settled, reads the unit's chart before the first write, and writes only structure and decisions, never state, closing only a post-merge issue whose every criterion it has verified

plugins.name: intake
plugins.description: Linear Triage sorter — reads the team's Triage inbox, moves each item it can place plainly and reversibly (chart root back to Backlog, a plain duplicate marked, a single chart match related and accepted), leaves the rest in Triage, and reports once with an undo per item; writes no descriptions, comments or issues

plugins.name: residue
plugins.description: Reads out what a session still holds open, on request — acts it owes, unanswered questions, findings made along the way — from a fresh read of the session's record and the unit's Linear chart, and sorts them into what stays in the session, what is proposed for the chart through /unfold, and what needs the user's decision; writes nothing to Linear itself

plugins.name: agent-device-preflight
plugins.description: Resolve agent-device attachment prerequisites before `open` — device lock state, signing team from the certificate OU, developer-account device registration, developer disk image mount, macOS DevToolsSecurity, stale runner cache and daemon environment, and physical-vs-virtual device selection

plugins.name: chrome-agent
plugins.description: Chrome operator subagent (sonnet) — delegate end-to-end browser flows to the Claude in Chrome extension, keeping screenshots and DOM out of the main context

plugins.name: ocu-agent
plugins.description: Desktop operator subagent (opus) — delegate macOS app work to Open Computer Use (ocu) in the background, keeping accessibility trees and screenshots out of the main context

plugins.name: choi-voice
plugins.description: Writing-voice polish profiles (LinkedIn)

plugins.name: explain
plugins.description: Explain a concept, codebase, paper, or system to one specific reader — sequenced on what that reader already holds, with the cognitive-science evidence behind each directive

plugins.name: higgsfield
plugins.description: Generate Seedance 2.5 video on Higgsfield through the higgsfield CLI — multi-shot cinematic clips with native dialogue, image-to-video, audio lipsync, clip edit and extension

plugins.name: ink-figure
plugins.description: Epistemic Ink output style, which renders what the epistemic protocols present and flags with a ↻ line a defect in an extension the user maintains once its admission checks pass, with a figure mod that draws the ```mermaid and ```math fences it writes as terminal figures — only what transcript text cannot draw; East Asian labels line up — and, with its figure board on, asks the model to keep each session's figures in one place the Claude apps can open

plugins.name: goal-research
plugins.description: Delegate external-source research to a background Claude or Codex run driving Aitesis (/inquire) with Tavily, hold it to the stated goal, and check its citations against its own Tavily record in a separate context (/goal-research)

plugins.name: review-loop
plugins.description: Convergence-paced review-resolve loop over a change and its governing surfaces — verifies each finding against the codebase and its base, then re-reviews until each is disposed of (/review-loop)

plugins.name: motion
plugins.description: Turn a vague wish for a motion-graphics video into a rendered mp4: /elicit shows how it read the request in newcomer terms and the build starts at once without waiting on it (an interrupt stops a wrong reading), then the mp4 is rendered and shown to approve or change, with /sketch or /preview from it where a change must be seen to be judged (/motion)

plugins.name: ghostty-split
plugins.description: Opens the other side of /branch and /fork in a Ghostty split: the original on the left after /branch, the background session on the right after /fork.

plugins.name: kakao
plugins.description: Several macOS KakaoTalk chat rooms in parallel, one Claude session per room window — opened in the background, then read, drafted, sent and screenshotted through Accessibility, with no server, keyboard events or window raising

plugins.name: ntfy-checkpoint
plugins.description: Phone push at a set minute for a one-shot checkpoint, scheduled on ntfy ahead of time with no visible list — one ntfy MCP server per area, work and personal; a handoff goes through aiward where its sender is installed

plugins.name: findmy-location
plugins.description: Read where the user is right now from the macOS Find My app, when a task needs the user's current location as context

plugins.name: aiward
plugins.description: Report a session to aiward, choi's observer session, when the issue it carried settles or stops — the observer reads the session's own record and tells it to go on, pushes choi, or neither
